title: FloodLine simulated incident report
description: A full, versioned snapshot of a fictional flood report. Caller evidence is retained in transcript turns; current facts and model summaries are interpretations. Cross-version and evidence rules are documented in README.md.

schema_version.description: Contract version, independent of the report revision number.

simulated.description: This initial contract accepts simulated reports only.

report_id.description: Opaque application-assigned identifier, stable across all updates.

provider_call_id.description: Opaque call correlation identifier, with no provider-specific format. Null until available; never use it as the report ID.

version.description: Starts at 1 and increases by exactly one per accepted update.

transcript.description: Append-only evidence in conversation order. Preserve recognized wording, including uncertainty and superseded statements. An empty array permits creation before speech.

summary.description: Model-generated interpretation, never a caller quotation or a verified operational assessment.

reported_location.description: Current interpretation of the caller's reported incident location; never silently substitute the caller's phone location or a guessed address.

precision.description: Specificity of the available evidence, not confidence or independent verification. Use unknown when no usable location is known.

coordinates.description: Optional WGS84 decimal degrees; omit when unavailable. Zero is a valid latitude or longitude. All values in this contract are fictional simulation data.

source.description: Caller-spoken coordinates or explicit synthetic fixture coordinates. Model guesses are not a coordinate source.

count.description: Caller-reported total people affected at this location, not just trapped people. Null is unknown; zero is an explicit report of none.

includes_children.description: True: children reported; false: caller explicitly says no children; null: unknown.

hazards.description: Each flag is an independent caller-reported condition. Silence is null, never false. These flags do not encode severity or a dispatch decision.

unknown_fields.description: Exactly one entry per unresolved incident field, including omitted coordinates; use JSON Pointers, with no entries for known false or zero. Metadata such as an unavailable provider_call_id is outside this list.

review_status.description: Pending human review; flagged for human attention; or explicitly reviewed by a human. A model must never set reviewed. Review does not imply dispatch or independently verified truth.

revisions.description: Append-only revision index with one entry per report version. Retain each prior full snapshot as well; this index is not a replacement for snapshot history.

changed_fields.description: Changed top-level content fields; creation lists all content fields. Version, timestamps and this revision index are bookkeeping, not listed here.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp including timezone. Enable format checking in the validator.

turnIds.description: References to caller turn IDs in this snapshot. Empty only when no caller evidence exists for this value or annotation.

text.description: Recognized caller wording or assistant wording as spoken, never a rewritten summary. Simulation examples contain fictional speech.
